newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber adrift, small-lot buying seen.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber adrift, small-lot buying seen.

text.p: Trading in the Singapore rubber market was marked by some small-lot buying by midday on Friday, but most players were on the sidelines looking for direction in the afternoon session, dealers said.
"There was some buying done in the ring sessions for RSS1 rubber and TSR20 rubber, but it was very quiet all around as people got ready for the weekend," one dealer said.
Major consumers were not seen in the market in early Friday trade on expectations that prices still have some room to come off, traders said.
"I did not get any call from the big boys. We'll get a better feel of the market this afternoon," a trader said.
Dealers said the Japanese market did not inspire the local market as Tokyo rubber futures fell while Kobe futures rose in morning trade.
At 0445 GMT, June RSS3 was indicated at 107.50 U.S. cents a kg from 108.00 cents.
June RSS1 was seen at 155.00-157.00 Singapore cents (US$1.07-$1.09) a kg from 156.25 cents.
June TSR20 was seen at 150.25 Singapore cents (US$1.04) a kg from 150.00 cents. -- (US$1-S$1.44) Rene Pastor (65-8703305)
